propositions: A provider-neutral mapping_config module must establish schema, merge rules, and fail-closed validation before any axis can be wired to config
The [tool.rebar.mapping] section must be registered as reserved so its keys bypass _warn_unknown coercion even under REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error

Axis maps (status_map, type_map, link_map, priority_map, create_defaults) must deep-merge per key across layers (built-in ← default ← projects.KEY), while vocabulary declarations (statuses, issue_types, link_types, hierarchy) must replace wholesale with most-specific layer winning

Validation must fail offline when axis-map values reference undeclared vocabulary, blocks are malformed (non-mapping subtables, non-string values, non-string-list vocabularies), or capability-absent axes are referenced

A Capability descriptor dataclass must declare which axes a target supports (has_types, has_transitions, has_hierarchy, has_link_types, has_priorities) as data distinct from backend operation protocols
The core module must remain provider-neutral, importing no adapters.jira* code, with vendors injecting defaults and capabilities respecting the one-way vendor-adapter seam dependency
